card.base: flex flex-col gap-6 overflow-hidden rounded-xl py-6 transition-all duration-200

variants.executive: bg-gradient-to-b from-white/90 to-slate-50/80 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm

slots.header: @container/card-header grid auto-rows-min grid-rows-[auto_auto] items-start gap-2 px-6 has-data-[slot=action]:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] [.border-b]:pb-6
slots.title: font-editorial text-lg font-bold leading-none tracking-tight
slots.footer: flex items-center px-6 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 text-xs font-interface

slots.header: h-16 px-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-inherit shrink-0
slots.content: flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-4 space-y-6 scrollbar-thin
slots.groupLabel: px-2 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-semibold
slots.navItem: flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-xs font-interface font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors duration-150
slots.footer: p-3 border-t border-inherit shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px]

table.wrapper: relative w-full overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-inherit shadow-sm

slots.thead: bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border-b border-inherit text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400
slots.tdCode: py-3 px-3 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-inqaba-navy dark:text-sky-400 align-middle
slots.tdAmount: py-3 px-3 font-mono font-medium text-right tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 align-middle
slots.tdHash: py-3 px-3 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 align-middle
slots.caption: mt-4 text-xs text-slate-400 text-center font-interface

badge.base: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider border

variants.audited: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/60
variants.flagged: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800/60
variants.critical: bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800/60
variants.neutral: bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700
